**Job Description**

Responsibilities : Oversee procurement operations across multiple categories, ensuring timely and compliant execution of sourcing activities. Manage tactical and spot buy requests, including specification development, supplier solicitation, bid analysis, and negotiation. Ensure completion of all pre-contract sourcing solution activities, aligning with client expectations and internal governance. Drive contractual and realized savings in line with client engagement commercials and procurement transformation goals. Develop and execute category strategies, including baselining, market intelligence gathering, and stakeholder alignment. Monitor and deliver on category-specific savings commitments, milestones, and obligations through structured project planning. Lead e-sourcing initiatives by managing e-RFx events, creating templates, conducting supplier training, and analyzing outcomes. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure sourcing strategies are aligned with broader business objectives and risk frameworks.

**Qualifications**

Bachelors - Business Administration, Bachelors - Industrial Engineering, Bachelors - Logistics, Bachelors - Supply Chain Management, Masters - Operations Management

**Certifications**

Certified Professional in Supply Management (CPSM) - Institute for Supply Management (ISM)Institute for Supply Management (ISM), Certified Supply Chain Professional (CSCP) - Indian Institute of Management, TrichyIndian Institute of Management, Trichy
